title: 關係子句
point: 關係詞題先看前面的名詞是人、物還是地點，再看空格後面缺什麼：缺主詞、缺受詞、接名詞，還是已經是完整子句。
formula: 先行詞 + who/which/that/whose/where + 子句（整段修飾前面的名詞）

parts.text: who repaired the server last night

table.en: the manager who approved the budget
table.rule: 先行詞是人，在子句中當主詞用 who，後面直接接動詞

table.zh: 我們面試過的那位應徵者
table.rule: 先行詞是人，在子句中當受詞用 whom，後面接主詞 + 動詞

table.en: the report which / that was submitted
table.rule: 先行詞是物，用 which 或 that

table.en: the client whose order was delayed
table.rule: whose + 名詞表示所有關係（誰的什麼）
先行詞是地點，where 後面接主詞 + 動詞都齊全的完整子句
子句缺受詞（booked 後面沒東西）時用 which 或 that，不用 where

examples: The consultant who reviewed our contracts will present the findings on Friday.
The assistant who arranged the flights will send the itinerary tomorrow.
story: A customer whose package arrived damaged called the support center on Monday.
The agent who took the call offered a full refund right away.
She also shipped a replacement from the warehouse where the company keeps its spare stock.
The next day, the customer posted a review that praised the quick response.

drills.prompt: Did the agent offer the customer a refund?
drills.fix: who took the call 只是說明是哪位客服，主詞 The agent 的動詞是 offered。

drills.prompt: Where did the replacement come from?
drills.fix: where 後面接完整子句 the company keeps its spare stock，用來說明前面的 warehouse。

drills.prompt: The client ___ invoice was missing called again.
drills.fix: 空格後面緊接名詞 invoice，表示「客戶的發票」，所有關係用 whose。
